INSERT INTO organization_seller_profiles (
            organization_id, status, content, created_by_user_id, updated_by_user_id
         )
         VALUES ($1, 'ACTIVE'::seller_profile_status, $2::jsonb, $3, $3)
         ON CONFLICT (organization_id) DO UPDATE
             SET status = 'ACTIVE'::seller_profile_status,
                 content = EXCLUDED.content,
                 updated_by_user_id = EXCLUDED.updated_by_user_id
         RETURNING id
